notes.title: New patch update v19.0.8
notes.content:
Following the release of our patch for the PC version, we've got some patch lovin for our Mac users too!

In this version of the patch, we've fixed the following:

- A context menu no longer appears when right-clicking wall cabinets.

- Railing elevation is now set correctly when copying/moving to a different floor.

- Assume you place several plants, display the plant inventory on the left sidebar, and switch to the 3D Elevation mode.  Performing an undo will no longer display the plant inventory.

- Displaying patterned objects (details, decks, etc.) in 2D is now much faster.

- Improved gable creation in certain cases when using the automatic roof generator.

- Pressing the Escape key will now deselect any selected geometry if the 2D or 3D view has focus.

- Opening multiple documents using File | Open now opens all of the selected files in the correct design mode.

- Fixed an issue where changing the content column count in Preferences may cause unexpected behavior when dragging-and-dropping content.
